summary: Insolvency Resolution Process set-off right; Corporate Debtor assets custody vs mutual debts; statutory set-off in IBC 2016; insolvency moratorium under Section 14(4) bars cross-claim adjustments; mutual debts must be liquidated, connected; pre-adjudication reciprocal claims eligible for set-off; contractual set-off requirements examined; insolvency set-off recognized under Section 238; Adjudicating Authority order allowing set-off overturned, NCLAT affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCLAT judgment upheld; set-off claim disallowed during Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
